Full definitions of generalized ambigraph functions Xi/pi and matroid characteristic polynomial supplied. Standard Whitney/NBC forms are prior background and specializations.

core_obligations: The author constructs a broken-circuit edge-toggle involution that preserves the relevant connected/union or rank data while reversing signs, and proves compatibility with arbitrary selected broken-circuit weights. The same mechanism survives ambigraph edge structure and general coefficient targets, including vertex weights/noncommuting chromatic variables, and yields the matroid characteristic-polynomial identity. Ambigraph and matroid formulations are one cancellation object, not separate counts; all standard Whitney/NBC specializations and applications are context.
